_doc: The bones a rigid gear component's one blend of weights may use, by slot (tools/armor/gear_fit.py rigid_blend). A rigid component (a plate, its rivets) never bends: it takes one blend, B's skin weights averaged over its bound points. That mean takes in every bone her skin there follows (the breast springs, the neck, the clavicle under a cuirass), and the whole plate then swings with each. Here each slot names the roles its plates may ride ("ride") and each role's share of the blend: a number is a fixed share; "mean" is the share that role already has in the mean. With "one_bone" each role's share goes to its strongest bone in the mean (a plate on one bone moves rigidly; a blend of two turning bones shrinks and shears it), else bones keep their proportions from the mean; a role the mean does not reach rides its anchor bone ("{s}" the side the mean leans to). Bones are given roles by the first pattern they match (regex, whole name). A slot not listed keeps the mean as it is. A new slot or a new body's bones need only this file. "standoff" (a slot's stand-off law): its plates stand off her where her skin measurably rises under them as she moves (tools/armor/gear_standoff.py measures each plate vertex's target clearance over the clips; gear_fit build clears each rigid component to its targets, each held at "cap_mm"; "margin_mm" over the measured need), and the tuck under them (gear_tuck's rule under a rigid plate) is full within "tuck_full_mm", none past "tuck_zero_mm", rising at most "tuck_step" a skin edge in from the edge of the skin it covers. "worn_rest" (a slot names a spring group; the top-level "worn_rest" names the springs file and its body row): that slot's rigid components are made to measure for her body AS WORN under the piece, not for the bare bind (tools/armor/worn_rest.py: the piece's hold gives her support, which rests her springs elsewhere, a push-up lifts each breast's tip about 20 mm, and sets her form_support shapes; a plate that rides the spine does not follow by itself). A piece with no hold, a body without those bones: nothing changes.
_group: THE GROUP (gear_fit GROUP, lane G solver round 11, 17 Nov): slots.<slot>.group fits each side's plates of an armor row (a pauldron's cop and its lames, with what rides them) as ONE rigid group placed as A arranges them: one similarity onto their carried places, then one translation and per-axis scales about the top plate's centre against the stand-off law ("turn" true adds a turn about its middle). A's overlaps hold by construction; motion stays per plate (A's blends).
_stack: THE STACK (gear_fit STACK, lane G solver round 7, 17 Nov): a slot with "stack" fits each side's plates top down; a plate hung under another (a pauldron's lames) takes its parent's fit over A's own arrangement (A's rest, so A's overlaps hold), then swings out on its top hinge (the major axis of its overlap zone, points within reach_mm of the parent) by the least angle that meets the stand-off law, at most max_deg; the zone under the parent is exempt. PARKED (no slot has it): on B's warden pauldron the chain alone gives A's rest overlaps exactly (cop|l1 820/599/963 mm^2 front/out/in vs A 816/600/958) but her skin through the lames at close 0 -> 1229 mm^2 (idle_warden_town 9.4 mm: the tuck does not cover B's arm under A's arrangement); the hinge cannot meet the rest floor (lame 1 hits max_deg 35 with 9 mm left: its front and back ends lie near the hinge line). Round 9 (17 Nov, gear_tuck through-a-rigid-face + THE STACK AS TUCKED: the floor off her skin as the plates' cover tucks it), PARKED again: hinge, after 2 fresh stand-off rounds every lame hits max_deg (left 5-23 mm), gear_wear close 0 -> 1169 mm^2 (idle_warden_town 19.7 mm, upper arm L), leap 3071 -> 5602, sword_heavy 1718 -> 3700, play ex 2719 -> 2590, rest cop|l1 641/477/733 (A 816/600/958; 894/619/969 before the rounds): the clip targets ask more than a top hinge gives. 'fit': 'clear' (the child made to measure from A's arrangement: the lone fit's least translation and scales) is built, measured only at round 0 (lame 2 moved 8.8 / 11.7 mm out, scales unused).
_support_follow: slots.<slot>.support_follow true, or a law over gear_fit SUPPORT_FOLLOW (lane G builder round 13 of body-b-warden-outfit, 17 Nov): a band's end takes its cup's SUPPORT shape deltas (form_support_lift / _press / _fill), full within near_mm of the cup or its rim at rest, a cosine fade to its own at fade_mm, two cups mixed by their shares; a small part lying on a band (ring, laces) takes one delta, the mean of its points'. Cups, rims, rivets, positions (support 0) and every other shape untouched; runs only on a body with a worn rest. Cause (lead 6, in-engine): at support 1 B's right cup moves (+11.8 in, +11.3 up, +3.3 fwd) mm while the band end's deltas faded with distance (20-40 mm: 7.4/7.4), uncovering the band end behind the cup's outer rim (the look camera's knot). PARKED (no slot has it; on: "support_follow": true): built on B (warden.top: 2 bands, 118 riders, 6993 points, at most 8.35 mm), near 40 / fade 100: at the look camera the black spot and most of the leather wedge went but a trim sliver stayed; at close_town_day the band bent up along its last 40-100 mm (a kink and a new light sliver at its back end), and at the worn rest 149 band-leather points went up to 3.7 mm inside her skin (z -0.03..0.02). Near 30 / fade 70 (no leather inside, min 0.3 mm): the knot came back at look, a smaller kink at close. The knot reaches 40-70 mm along the band, where her flank under it does not move with the cup.
_trim_ride: slots.<slot>.trim_ride {host_mat, mats, ride_mm, share, near_mm, fade_mm} over gear_fit TRIM_RIDE (trim_ride_rule; lane G rim2, 17 Nov): a component of the piece's trim ("mats": the gold) with share of its points within ride_mm of the piece's big bendy steel at the built rest rides that steel: each point takes the steel's skin weights (top 8) and every shape delta at its nearest steel point (a shape the steel lacks is 0 there), full within near_mm, a cosine fade to its own by fade_mm; rest positions untouched; a rigid rivet on the steel rides it per point; a strap trim, the medallion and a rigid group shared with another mesh keep their own. Cause (godot/.shots/refit_b/rimd): each layer took B's blend shapes (support lift/press; arm_hang_* on the gold only) and weights at its own bound point, so the cup-edge gold set 0.3-0.4 mm under the steel came out through it as she moved (in engine up to 2.07 / 3.21 mm, her L / R cups): jagged bronze in the steel band at her left cup's lower inner rim by the sun medallion at the close and front look cameras. warden.top on B: 2 cup-edge trims + 32 rivets ride (17867 vertices). Offline (gear_wear poser, idle_warden_town, every 10th frame): the trim's offset change off its steel pct1/99 L -0.80..0.81 -> -0.19..0.30 mm, R -0.68..0.80 -> -0.54..0.30; rivets +-0.85 -> -0.15..0.10 mm; trim points inside the steel at the bind (2259) that come out in a frame, by winding number (godot/.shots/refit_b/rim3/wind.py): 44 (22 over 0.3 mm, max 1.41) -> 9 (none over 0.3 mm, max 0.27, none facing front over 0.1). The nearest-face sign test still reads 33 + 33 crossings and 2-3 mm movers at the shell's sharp edges: an artefact (the nearest point lies on an edge, the offset runs along the face, the posed nearest face switches).
_a_points: slots.<slot>.a_points {mats, ride_mm, ride_share} (gear_fit a_points_on; lane G round 15, 17 Nov): a calling (outfit) row's bendy pieces of those materials, and every piece with ride_share of its points within ride_mm of them at A's rest (rims, rivets, stitches, the leather on them), take A's own weights per point by joint name (a point naming a joint the body lacks keeps the body's); band and straps keep her skin's. warden.top on B: the steel cup rode B's skin (breast_tip_r .41, spine_04 .39; A: spine_03 .50, breast_r .39) and pivoted up at its tip in her idles, opening the band end at her right cup (the look camera's knot). PARKED (no slot has it; on: "a_points": {"mats": ["steel"], "ride_mm": 4.0, "ride_share": 0.5}): measured posed at idle_warden_look f150 against A, the cup's height is the worn rest, not the blend. Without the worn carry B's own skin blend sits within 0.8 mm of A everywhere and A's blend 0.6-3.6 mm high; with it, B's blend is +0.3 mm by the band to +22.7 beyond 100 mm and A's +0.6 to +21.9, and A's sank the cup's band end 3.2 mm back.
_band_end: slots.<slot>.band_end true, or a law over gear_fit BAND_END (lane G round 13, 17 Nov): a band's end follows its cup. Where a band (a big part reaching 2+ cups: the warden top's back band, its gold trim riding it, its ring) meets a cup, its points take the cup's own A->B move (the cup's nearest points, A's rest to this body's worn rest, less the band point's own), full within near_mm, a cosine fade to none at fade_mm. B's worn rest lifts the cups 15 mm up, 7 forward; the band, fit to her skin, stayed 5-12 mm inside the lifted cup: a knot of ring, trim and skin at her right cup's outer edge at the look camera. PARKED (no slot has it): B's band end already sits against its cup's edge as on A (posed, within 0.1-0.9 mm); the lift is the cup's tip pivoting on its outer edge (breast_tip_r blend), and the rule moved the band end off the cup by 1-3 mm (gear_fit BAND_END).
_a_blend: slots.<slot>.a_blend true (gear_fit A_BLEND; main's call 17 Nov, lane G): an armor row's plates ride A's own blend of each plate by joint name on every body (the slot's ride rule only for a joint the body lacks), and a small part whose A blend is not its leader's rides the nearest plate with its own. plate_pauldrons_warden on B: the one-bone rule rode the right cop on upperarm_twist_02_r alone (A: clavicle_r .70, delt_r .16, upperarm_share_r .10), so it faced 66-76 deg from up in her idles against A's 50-57: darker, flatter.
_rim_of: plate_pauldrons_warden on B (solver U, 17 Nov; slots.pauldrons rims stay false for the retired plain): each plate's rolled rim (close leaders 13, 15, 23 her right; 14, 18, 19 her left) rode its own fit and bone (the cop on upperarm_twist_02, its rim on upperarm_share; lame 2's rim 16.5 mm off its plate at rest), so in her idles the rims crossed their plates (cop dented, lames' lower edge frayed). A skins each plate and its rim with one blend: they ride as one.
_ride_plate: gear_fit plate_riders: an armor row's bendy part that A skins with its plate's one blend rides that plate (its fit, blend and mean shapes); value = near_mm. plate_pauldrons_warden's darkleather buckle strap: A's cop blend on A (clavicle .74), B's skin on B (67 blends), so it stood off the cop's side (solver U, 17 Nov).
_lead_of: a small component rides the plate A skins it with (A's blend identical), where the bind's nearest-big-component rule picked another: plate_pauldrons_warden's lame-1 gold trims (close 1 her right, 2 her left) rode lame 2 and stood 4-12 mm off lame 1 (solver U, 17 Nov).
